subject: Orion Health — custom log retention: proof-of-delete workflow & evidence
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@orionhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Orion Health Legal <legal@orionhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clarification: retention of inference logs for Orion Health

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick onboarding last week. As part of our internal audit and upcoming regulatory review, our compliance team has asked for clarity on Redwood's retention capabilities for tenant-scoped inference and operational logs. We have two specific asks: 

1) Can Redwood retain inference request/response logs, routing audit trails, and system error traces for a single tenant for up to 18 months? Our default understanding is that hosted accounts are on a 90-day rolling TTL.
2) For the 18-month requirement, we need (a) a documented retention policy/SOP that shows how data is tagged and retained per-tenant, (b) proof-of-delete artifacts (e.g., hash+timestamped audit entries from your delete job) when data is purged, and (c) a mapping of Redwood's log types to the SIG/CAIQ control IDs Orion tracks (particularly IA-5, IR-4 equivalents).

I've attached a short summary of Orion's minimum logging needs (orion_log_requirements.pdf). We will likely need either a contractual addendum or a small product change to persist these logs. Please confirm scope and next steps — ideally we need an evidence package by 11/16 for our DSM.

Regards,
Elaine Park
Director, Compliance
Orion Health

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@orionhealth.com>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Nov 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarification: retention of inference logs for Orion Health

Hi Elaine —

Thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. Short answer: we can support tenant-targeted retention beyond the hosted default, but the implementation and evidence vary by deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private).

A few clarifying questions to scope this properly:
- Which exact log classes must be retained for 18 months? (Please confirm if this includes full inference responses or only metadata/indices.)
- Is the retention requirement strictly for production tenant data, or do you also need platform-level forensic traces (node-level/system logs)?
- Do you require proof-of-delete for partial retention (e.g., remove PII fields) or full deletion of entire request/response objects?

Next steps I propose: 
1) We will provide a focused evidence pack containing our retention SOP excerpt, a sample deletion job audit (redacted), and a control mapping to SIG/CAIQ. I'm attaching our initial data extract that explains default retention boundaries (data-retention-extract.pdf) to give context.
2) Olga (cc'd) will provide a log-type mapping and an example proof-of-delete sample. Neha will confirm any SOC 2 control tieouts.

If this looks right, can we lock a short sync (30 minutes) tomorrow? If you prefer, we can start by exchanging the evidence artifacts over this thread.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@orionhealth.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Nov 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarification: retention of inference logs for Orion Health

Hi Elaine / team —

Adding the technical detail you requested. I'm attaching a CSV that maps Redwood's internal log buckets to the categories in your attachment (log-mapping-orion.csv) and a short plaintext sample of what our deletion audit looks like (deletion-proof-sample.txt). Highlights below: 

- What we call "inference request logs" = request metadata (timestamp, tenant_id, model_id, prompt hash), token counts, and an optional obfuscated response snapshot (if enabled). Full verbatim responses are considered sensitive and are not retained by default on Hosted unless a custom retention flag is set.
- "Routing audit trails" capture model routing decisions, policy fallbacks, and region selectors. These are lower-volume metadata logs and can be retained independently.
- "System error traces" include stack traces and GPU node IDs; we can configure redaction for node identifiers when export is required.

Implementation options for 18 months:
1) Hosted w/ customer-scoped retention flag: we can toggle a tenant-level retention to 18 months — we will surface TTL in the Console and capture the retention job audit logs. Exportable evidence includes the TTL config screenshot, deletion job run logs, and an aggregate hash list per purge.
2) Dedicated: retention configured at the pool level with stronger isolation — evidence includes tenant config exports and management-plane audit logs (S3 export of purged object manifests).
3) Private: customer controls retention; we provide the SOP and scripts used in-house as reference.

Deliverables I can prepare by 11/16 if we confirm scope: retention-SOP excerpt, sample purge job audit (redacted), tenant TTL screenshot, and a SIG/CAIQ control mapping (partial).

Notes on proof-of-delete: our pattern is to record a deletion manifest containing object IDs, a SHA256 of the stored object (or its canonical form), a timestamp, and the operator/service account that initiated the job. We retain those manifests in an append-only audit store for 90 days by default — we can extend that retention for your account to 18 months as part of the addendum. The attached deletion-proof-sample.txt is a redacted sample of that manifest.

I'll prepare the SOP and config screenshots and send them in a follow-up once you confirm which log classes you need retained.

—Olga
Principal Systems Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@orionhealth.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Orion Health Legal <legal@orionhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Nov 2028 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarification: retention of inference logs for Orion Health

Olga, Jonas —

Thanks, that level of detail is helpful. For clarity, please assume: 
- Scope = production tenant inference request metadata + routing audit trails + system error traces. We do NOT require full verbatim responses to be retained.
- Proof-of-delete = we need the deletion manifest + the operator audit entry + a demonstration of how to verify the SHA256 against a stored (redacted) object identifier.
- Control mapping = please call out the CAIQ/SIG control IDs you relate each log type to (we will hand this up to our auditor).

Two asks to finish the package: 
1) A one-page sample "proof-of-delete" package (redacted) that the auditor can review.
2) A draft addendum statement (DocuSign-ready) that commits Redwood to 18-month retention for the specified classes and to produce deletion manifests on request. I have attached Orion's SAR template to help (Orion_SAR_template.docx).

If you can deliver the sample package + SOP + control mapping by 11/16, we can route to our audit team. Also, we'll likely want a short signature addendum; could you connect me to your contracts lead once the tech package is complete?

Best,
Elaine

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@orionhealth.com>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Nov 2028 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarification: retention of inference logs for Orion Health

Elaine —

Appreciate the clear scope. Attached is the evidence bundle we've prepared for Orion given the production-only retention boundary you described. Attachments in this message: retention-sop.pdf, screenshot-tenant-ttl.png, deletion-playbook.md, sig-control-mapping.xlsx. Highlights: 

- retention-sop.pdf: contains the per-tenant retention workflow, tagging policy, and operator controls for the deletion job.
- screenshot-tenant-ttl.png: Console screenshot showing the tenant-level TTL set to 18 months (redacted tenant id).
- deletion-playbook.md: contains the sequence for the purge job plus the sample deletion manifest format and how to verify SHA256 entries.
- sig-control-mapping.xlsx: maps Redwood log types to CAIQ control IDs and notes where additional evidence is required for attestations.

We have also opened a support ticket for your account (RI-75241) to track the export of a one-off deletion manifest and to capture the management-plane audit logs. Link: https://support.redwoodai.com/ticket/RI-75241. 

Next steps: 
- Please confirm acceptance of the evidence package and whether you'll want the contractual addendum. 
- If yes, I will loop in our contracts lead and send a DocuSign-ready addendum; for tracking I've linked the HubSpot deal HB-90821.
- If your auditor wants live verification, we can schedule a time for Olga to demonstrate the deletion job against a redacted example.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call if useful.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
